card.text: Explore the Sun in 3D with cssEarth. Discover our nearest star, its glowing atmosphere, and the science behind the center of the solar system.

introduction.text: At the center of our solar system, the Sun is a 4.5-billion-year-old yellow dwarf star. Its light and heat make life on Earth possible.

photosphere.title: HMI continuum mosaic CR2311
photosphere.summary: Visible-light observations span May–June 2026. Color and brightness are adjusted; missing polar coverage is filled.

magnetic.title: HMI radial magnetic field CR2311
magnetic.summary: Colors show the radial field on a nonlinear scale. Measurements span May–June 2026 rather than a single instant.

chromosphere.title: AIA 304 Å synoptic map CR2311
chromosphere.summary: The 304 Å measurements span May–June 2026. Gaps use nearby latitudes; the separate outer image is from 27 May.

corona.title: AIA 171 Å synoptic map CR2311
corona.summary: The 171 Å measurements span May–June 2026. Gaps use nearby latitudes; the separate outer image is from 27 May.
